title: Using Get My Data – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50285138160915-Using-Get-My-Data#main-content)

* * *

**Description**

This quick guide outlines the steps required to obtain all practice data within Curve Hero using the Get My Data feature.

**About**

The Get My Data feature produces a downloadable text file that includes the information stored within a practice’s database. As this is a text file, it does not contain images or documents. For a complete copy of all practice information, contact the [Customer Service Team](https://www.curvedental.com/contact).

**Note**

This feature is only available to users with Administrator access.

**Steps**

1. In the Sidekick, click the **More** menu, then click **Administration** within the drop-down list.
![UGMD1.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53422375539219)
2. In the _Administration_ menu, within the _Reporting_ drop-down list, click **Get My Data**.
![UGMD2.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53422359145363)
3. In the Get My Data Module, click the **Get My Data** button.
![UGMD3.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53422359145875)
4. Within the _Download_ column, the spinner indicates the data is processing.
![UGMD4.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53422359146259)
5. When the process completes, click the **download** icon to download the data file.
![UGMD5.png](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/article_attachments/53422359147411)
